sql: with prior as (select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser, count(*) n, round(avg(pnl::numeric)*100,2) c from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and pnl is not null and created_at < '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z' group by 1 having count(*)>=30), fil as (select distinct f.market_ticker t from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Fmmsell10' and o.action='buy' and o.created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z'), post as (select split_part(p.market_ticker,'-',1) ser, count(*) n, round(avg(p.pnl::numeric)*100,2) c from paper_trades p where p.strategy='Fmmsell10_pt4' and p.pnl is not null and p.created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z' and p.market_ticker in (select t from fil) group by 1 having count(*)>=8) select ser, prior.n pn, prior.c pc, post.n qn, post.c qc from prior join post using (ser) order by prior.c
